title: Materials scientist: the metal acts like an animal seeking connection

tellings.quote: the words I heard this metal is much acts much like an animal in that it is always seeking for energy and seeking to connect

plain: A materials scientist is said to have described a strange metal as acting "much like an animal," in that it "is always seeking for energy and seeking to connect." Chris Bledsoe, a man who says he has had repeated UFO encounters, tells Michels these were the words he heard, in a setting linked to Silicon Valley and NASA in the 2020s. If true, it would describe a material that behaves almost like something alive.
